data.body: Explore what you value in a relationship and how you communicate it. This sample reading brings together relationship themes, life-period context and your chart reference.

factors.meaning: The reading refers to Thula Lagna in the selected demo chart.
Budha is the main period in this fixture timeline. A life period is different from a daily planetary hour.
Dated planetary movement contributes to a period interpretation. These factors are supplied fixtures, not calculated positions.
